name: File:0 Ghost Killer Kamimura Rei
original_name: ＦＩＬＥ：０ ゴーストキラー・神村 麗
source:
Kamimura Rei is a ghost killer. She is assisted by shrine maiden Shirui Mika who can listen to the spirits of the deceased. Together they solve thee spirit-related cases. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
神村麗是一名惡靈獵人。聽得見亡者靈魂的聲音的巫女紫衣美香擔任她的助手，兩人攜手解決各種靈異案件。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
